thread:
harper: Throwing up a thread for "quiet handoff" edge cases we didn't cover in the RFC draft. Want to list weird failure modes before we ship.
lucas: good idea. quick list: overlapping grace windows, stagger overlap (two regions ramping same tenant), and rollbacks racing each other.
anya: also: partial-residency tenants (some data EU-only, other meta global)  -> how strict is the router?
harper: For partial-residency we should have a "residency_leash_seconds" that caps cross-region time for a tenant and forces local-only after expiry unless operator extends.
lucas: Agree. Suggest policy example (RFC-friendly):
```
{
  "residency": "eu",
  "residency_leash_seconds": 300,
  "allow_transient_cross": true,
  "audit_on_cross": true,
  "degradation_ladder": ["cached_reply","smaller_model","fallback_model"],
  "prefetch_top_n": 75
}
```
anya: Love the degradation ladder field. Router should prefer stepping down the model before crossing region for strict tenants.
ops-bot: runbook note added: /runbooks/quiet-handoff -> edgecases.md appended (overlap rules, operator-extend steps, force-local script).
infra-bot: canary update: quiet-handoff-edge -> eu-slice-B -> bias=15% -> prewarm completed for cohort-1.
lucas: Overlap rules: if two rollouts target same tenant (region-A ramping and region-B ramping), we pick the higher-priority rollout (operator-specified) and pause the other. Need an operator flag `--priority` on rollout CLI.
harper: Good. Also: race between rollback and commit. We should require a final reconciliation step: controller writes final state to tenancy metadata and only then route controllers accept commits. Two-phase commit-ish but lightweight.
anya: KMS note: for transient cross decrypts we can't hand envelope keys to remote. Use ephemeral decrypt tokens from regional KMS proxy with TTL <= residency_leash_seconds and emit key-usage audit events.
legal: audit fields must include tenant_id, residency_leash_seconds, operator_id, rollout_id, reason, and whether any PII was present. EU tenant audits must remain in EU storage. We'll add schema.
lucas: Telemetry guards: p95_delta > sla + 25ms for 90s OR 5xx > 1.5x baseline for 60s OR remote_kv_miss_rate > 2.5x for 2m. Any of those trips auto-fires rollback.
harper: Also track "stutter" metric: number of route flips for a tenant in a 10m window. If >3, suspend rollouts for that tenant.
anya: Prefetch detail: top-N keys + warming via sampled prompts with rate cap (e.g., 0.5qps per tenant) and cost budget. If prefetch cost > budget, degrade prefetch and annotate reason.
lucas: Model catalog addition: each variant must include "compatibility_hash" for tokenizer/vocab and "cost_tier" so router can prefer cheaper compatible variant before crossing region.
ops-bot: runbook updated: added `force-local.sh` and `extend-leash` CLI examples.
infra-bot: telemetry: cohort-1 p95 stable, remote_kv_miss = 1.15x baseline, stutter = 0. infra-bot will continue ramp to 40% if metrics stable.
harper: Next actions: lucas -> add overlap priority + two-phase commit sketch to RFC; anya -> KMS proxy token flow and prefetch rate limits; legal -> audit schema final text; ops -> add CLI priority flag examples to runbook. Aim to merge RFC early next week.
legal: ACK on schedule; will send audit JSON schema by EOD.
harper: Thanks all. If stutter or rollback occurs, ops-bot please page oncall and attach last 15m routing diffs.
